APGN Champs Tournament

Quarterly championship for the top performers of Asia Pub Game Night

Proposal

The APGN Champs Tournament will be a quarterly 1v1 championship built around the existing Asia Pub Game Night (APGN). It gives the strongest monthly performers a chance to compete for a major quarterly title.

Qualification

  • APGN continues to run monthly.
  • The Top 5 verified winners from each month qualify.
  • Three months produce 15 qualified players.
  • The 15 qualifiers compete in the APGN Champs Tournament in the 1st week of the following quarter.
Example: January + February + March APGN qualifiers → April, 1st Week: APGN Champs Tournament.

APGN Champs Room

A separate private room called APGN Champs will be used for the qualified players and championship activities.

  • Each qualified player will be automatically vouched into the APGN Champs room.
  • Vouching will be done on the 1st day of the following month, once the APGN prizes have been distributed.
  • The room will serve as the dedicated space for qualified players leading up to the quarterly tournament.

Championship Rewards

🏆 Champion
Global Rank 1000 — APGN Champ
🥈 2nd Place
50 RGDs
🥉 3rd Place

Tournament Setup

  • Game: Warcraft III
  • Format: 1v1
  • Mode: -SDOM
  • Bot: SG (Asia Bot)
  • Participants: 15 qualified players

Quarterly Cycle

01Month 1 — APGN Game Night → Top 5 qualify
02Month 2 — APGN Game Night → Top 5 qualify
03Month 3 — APGN Game Night → Top 5 qualify
041st day of the following month — prizes distributed and qualifiers vouched into APGN Champs
051st week of the following quarter — 15 qualifiers compete in the APGN Champs Tournament

The same cycle repeats every quarter, creating a continuous path from the monthly APGN events to a recurring championship.
